# @toolsync/changesets

[![Homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-default)](https://toolsync.vercel.app)

A version of changesets that also works with bun

<!-- #endregion header -->

This is a drop-in replacement for [@changesets/cli](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@changesets/cli) that also works with [bun](https://bun.sh).

It adds the following features:

- Supports publishing packages with bun
- Supports running inside a workspace package directory (the original only works in the root of a monorepo)
- Bundles all `@changesets` packages into a single binary for faster startup and install times
- Still works with original GitHub Actions workflows etc.
